first.speaker: Mayor Tolle
first.text: So. The sea gave one back. We have not had that in a long time.

where.speaker: Mayor Tolle
where.text: Wrackmouth, in the kingdom of Vessary. We pick over what the tide leaves and we mind our own business. Nothing has happened here in years, and I would like it to stay that way.

menu.speaker: Mayor Tolle
menu.text: We are short of hands. I cannot feed a stranger for nothing, and I will not turn one out. Work, if you want to belong here.

accept.speaker: Mayor Tolle
accept.text: Three things, then. Orsa Kell at the forge wants salvage from your own wreck: there is a crate on the shore, north of here. There are rats in my cellar, and the holes are behind the Hall. And take this letter up to Teague at the Lantern Watch, on the headland.

accept_end.speaker: Mayor Tolle
accept_end.text: Nobody here will thank you for it. That is not the same as nobody noticing.

chores_reminder.speaker: Mayor Tolle
chores_reminder.text: The crate for Orsa, the rat holes behind the Hall, the letter for Teague. Come back when they are done.

assign_cairns.speaker: Mayor Tolle
assign_cairns.text: The rats have gone quiet and Teague has his letter. Ten coin; you have earned it.

assign_cairns2.speaker: Mayor Tolle
assign_cairns2.text: One more. Moonherb grows at the old cairns, south-west past the last houses. I need three sprigs for the fever that comes with autumn. Go before dusk. I would not walk there after.

cairns_reminder.speaker: Mayor Tolle
cairns_reminder.text: Three sprigs of moonherb from the cairns, south-west of the last houses. Before dusk.

report.speaker: Mayor Tolle
report.text: Moonherb, good. And what is that in your hand?

report2.speaker: You
report2.text: It was in a grave at the cairns. The grave was dug open from below. This mark was burned into the lid.

report3.speaker: Mayor Tolle
report3.text: I do not know that mark. I know the kind of person who makes them, and it is not a name I say before dark. Pell came in at dawn swearing the shore was clean as a plate: the old bones are gone. I thought he was drunk.

report4.speaker: Mayor Tolle
report4.text: Take it to the garrison at Crossholm, by the east road. Tell the captain what you found and where. I would not keep that under my roof. Fifteen coin for the road. Go carefully.

road_reminder.speaker: Mayor Tolle
road_reminder.text: East road to Crossholm. Give the bone to the garrison captain, and tell them everything.

after.speaker: Mayor Tolle
after.text: You came to us a stranger. Wrackmouth remembers who stayed to work. Whatever you find out there, you have a door here.
